items.name: Canvas Night
items.role: Default marketing canvas. Pure black, no tint.

items.name: Canvas Night Soft
items.role: Barely-lifted near-black for content sections that need a subtle separation from the pure-black hero.

items.name: Canvas Cool
items.role: A pale cool-blue-white used as the secondary surface on the shop site and as the hover-canvas of certain ghost buttons.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: Default text on dark canvas; the dominant text color across the marketing site.

items.name: On Primary Mute
items.role: Slightly cooled-white used for secondary text on dark surfaces — barely distinguishable from but enough to suggest a hierarchy.

items.name: Ink
items.role: Default text on light surfaces (shop site).

items.name: Link on Dark
items.role: Underlined inline link on dark canvas.

items.name: Link Blue Fallback
items.role: The browser default that appears in unstyled fallback contexts — documented for completeness, not used as a brand color.
